notes: All 6 required web searches ran in this second attempt (an earlier attempt had 5 of them refused). Only the search restricted to luttrell.house.gov returned anything about him; the superintelligence, extinction, pause, China agreement and 'AI safety' searches returned nothing mentioning him. Out of date range and left out: a 19 September 2023 interview republished on his site ('Next Frontier of Warfare', https://luttrell.house.gov/media/in-the-news/next-frontier-warfare-ex-navy-seal-turned-gop-congressman-readies-bipartisan) where he said 'Big government's too slow to keep pace with the advances in the artificial intelligence space' and 'Let the industry lead, and don't let the government stifle innovation.' No House letter about AI risk signed or led by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). A reviewer could reasonably choose D instead of none, since he has sponsored AI-related (pro-use) legislation, though no own-words AI statement in 2025-2026 was found.
